note: A Short's frame (the 9:16 cut) in fractions: left and right are shares of the width, everything else a share of the height, measured from the top. components/layout.ts turns them into pixels (useUpright, uprightStage). tests/test_upright.py checks that the zones do not overlap and that EDITOR.md's zone table quotes these numbers. A zone is corrected here and nowhere else.

youtube.note: What the Shorts player draws over the video: its header across the top 8%, the title strip across the bottom 15%, and the buttons down the right 15% from 45% of the height.

sticker.note: The hook sticker's band. On a scene whose caption sits at caption.set the sticker keeps its older place instead (9% down while it is big, then the smaller line recorded here as 'set').

caption.note: The caption is one line on a pill of one height. 'top' to 'bottom' is its band; a scene type listed under 'at' carries it at 'board' (the middle, under the board's own lines) or at 'set' (high, over a set piece's head) instead; every other type has it in the band, a compare among them now that its boxes are laid in the stage.

stage.note: Where a scene's own content goes: a stat, a pie, a chart, a compare, a receipt. It reaches 'right' above 'narrow_from' of the height and only 'narrow_right' below it, beside YouTube's buttons. Its foot depends on what stands under it: nothing, cards, a drawing or loop, or the character.

cards.note: The cards under a board's stage hang from 'right', where YouTube's buttons begin (paper/setpiece.tsx FootageCards; a set piece's column on the right stops there too). Beside a drawing or loop they start at 'beside_drawing'; beside the character they hang from 'beside_character' instead.

opener.note: A photo opener's big number (big= on footage, paper/scenes.tsx PaperBroll): where the block's foot and its right edge sit, above YouTube's title strip and left of its buttons.

drawing.note: A placed drawing or loop, bottom left (paper/art.tsx ArtLayer, paper/loops.tsx LoopLayer).

character.note: The posing character, lower right (paper/poses.tsx PoseLayer).
